author: Raul Montiel
why: Strong classic view: snow-covered cone, distinct summit plume and blue sky. Excellent volcano recognition for a poster crop; native dimensions unverified.

author: Irving Joaquin Gutierrez
why: 4000 × 6000 photograph of a night eruption with glowing incandescent material against a dark sky. Dramatic colour and portrait framing suit a 9:10 crop.

author: Sebastian Ashton
why: Sunrise view of Popocatépetl photographed from Iztaccíhuatl’s summit, explicitly identified by the photographer. Atmospheric alternative with warm sky; native dimensions unverified.

author: Irving Joaquin Gutierrez
why: 7360 × 4912 photograph showing the snow-capped volcano above forested foothills. Abundant resolution for selecting a near-square landscape crop.

author: Magaly Taboada
why: 3439 × 5158 portrait photograph of Popocatépetl from Cholula, combining the volcano, cityscape and clear blue sky. Useful contextual alternative.

author: Alexander Schimmeck
why: Photographer identifies Popocatépetl above Puebla/Cholula beneath blue sky. Recognisable regional setting, although the city shares attention; native dimensions unverified.
